I replied to Ilse in her DM to confirm the new date: her cutoff for the Quarrendon Freight Lines paperwork is now 7 July, and it stays in that DM.

I didn't save the note anywhere else. The only memory store I have is the shared knowledge brain, and other people could see it there. She asked to keep it between us, so I left it out. The note lives only in that DM, and it will still be there if she brings it up later.
